Jordan Firstman Made Club Kid as ‘An Act of Compassion for Myself’

For Jordan Firstman, tears shed during the making of Club Kid would turn out to be a harbinger of success. “I remember getting to the end of the edit, and I would cry every time watching it,” he recalls over Zoom. “My editor would cry every time. Everyone who was allowed in the edit was crying. And so I knew people were gonna be moved.” What the actor, writer, and internet personality did not predict for his feature debut was just how big and immediate that impact …
